user.title: 2GIG GC3 panel
user.description: Enter the panel's address and the API credentials (captured from a paired controller — see the docs).

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the panel.
data_description.api_key: The X-Api-Key issued to a paired controller.
data_description.disarm_pin: User PIN used to disarm (leave blank to be prompted for a code each time).
data_description.port: The panel's API port. Almost always 3000.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the GC3 panel
reconfigure.description: Update the panel's address, credentials or disarm PIN.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the panel.
data_description.api_key: The X-Api-Key issued to a paired controller.
data_description.disarm_pin: User PIN used to disarm (leave blank to be prompted for a code each time).
data_description.port: The panel's API port. Almost always 3000.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate GC3
reauth_confirm.description: The panel rejected the stored credentials. Enter current values.

data_description.api_key: The X-Api-Key issued to a paired controller.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the panel.
error.invalid_auth: The panel rejected the API/pairing key.
error.unknown: Unexpected error talking to the panel.

abort.wrong_panel: The address entered belongs to a different panel than the one being reconfigured.

data.no_entry_delay: No entry delay when armed home or away
data.night_no_entry_delay: No entry delay when armed night

data_description.poll_interval: How often to read the panel's status and zones. The panel is local; 3 seconds is fine.
data_description.no_exit_delay: Arm instantly instead of counting down the exit delay.
data_description.no_entry_delay: Sound the alarm the moment an entry zone opens, instead of allowing time to disarm. Leave this off unless you disarm some other way, or walking in your own front door will trip the siren.
data_description.night_no_entry_delay: The same, for night mode only. Instant is the conventional meaning of arming night, but the siren sounds with no chance to disarm first.
data_description.bypass_not_ready: Arm even when zones are open, bypassing them, instead of failing.

command_failed.message: The GC3 panel rejected the command: {error}

no_disarm_pin.message: No disarm PIN was provided. Enter a PIN in the dialog, or store one in the integration's settings.

zone_supervision_lost.title: Zone "{zone}" is no longer reporting
zone_supervision_lost.description: The panel has lost supervision of the sensor for "{zone}". It is usually a dead battery, a sensor that has been removed, or one that is out of range. The zone's state in Home Assistant is stale until the panel hears from it again.
